title: Supernatural Breakthrough
summary: Discover how God breaks out against every opposition like a burst of overwhelming waters. Step into supernatural acceleration and victory over ancestral barriers.
notes:
1. The God of Baal-Perazim breaks through before us.
2. Inquire of the Lord before every battle.
3. The sound of marching in the mulberry trees signifies divine alliance.
4. Breakthrough is not accidental; it is covenantal.

title: The Baal-Perazim Mandate
summary: Understanding the spiritual mandate given to Perazim Mission Church. When the enemy gathers in the valley of giants, God unleashes breakthrough power that establishes His kingdom.
notes:
1. The valley of Rephaim is the place of confrontation.
2. Divine strategy overrules natural strength.
3. David burned the idols of the Philistines.
4. Walking under the mandate requires pure devotion.

title: Walking in Faith and Favor
summary: Faith activates the favor of God that surrounds the righteous as with a shield. Learn how to speak faith into dry situations and expect supernatural favor in marketplaces and careers.
notes:
1. Faith sees the invisible, believes the incredible, and receives the impossible.
2. Favor is God's endorsement upon your labor.
3. Confession aligns reality with heaven's decree.
4. Without faith it is impossible to please Him.

title: Overcoming Mountains
summary: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the Lord. Speak grace, grace to every immovable mountain standing between you and your God-given destiny.
notes:
1. Identify the mountain: stagnation, sickness, or lack.
2. Speak directly to the obstacle with authority.
3. Faith does not negotiate with mountains; it commands them to move.
4. Shout 'Grace, grace to it!'

title: The Breakthrough Anointing
summary: The breaker goes up before them; they break out and pass by the gate. Experience the yoke-destroying power of the Holy Spirit in every area of life.
notes:
1. The Breaker is Christ Himself leading the procession.
2. The anointing breaks the yoke of limitation.
3. Consecration precedes manifestation.
4. Step forward without fear; the path has been cleared.

title: Possessing Your Possessions
summary: Upon Mount Zion there shall be deliverance, and holiness, and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions. Reclaim every spiritual and physical blessing promised in the covenant.
notes:
1. Deliverance sets you free; possession keeps you victorious.
2. Every place the sole of your foot treads is yours.
3. Be strong and very courageous.
4. The Word in your mouth is the weapon of occupation.
